title: Procjena cloud provajdera i AI/ML
summary: Procjena cloud provajdera (ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 2 Type II, CSA STAR i CCM, Common Criteria, FIPS 140-3) i AI/ML u cloud sigurnosti: detekcija, validacija izvora podataka, SOAR, etika i regulativa (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001).
title_en: Evaluating cloud service providers and AI/ML
